Package model

Klasse StatisticsManager

java.lang.Object
model.StatisticsManager
public class StatisticsManager extends Object
Calculates real-time statistics based on the current state of vehicles in the simulation.

This class processes raw vehicle data to derive meaningful metrics such as:

  • Average network speed
  • Congestion spots (edges with low average speeds)
  • Vehicle density per edge
  • Travel time distribution (histograms)
It is designed to be updated in every simulation step via step(Map, int).
Autor:
Minh Khoi

  • Methodendetails

    • step

      public void step(Map<String,VehicleClass> vehiclesInfo, int step)
      Updates the internal state with the latest vehicle data from the simulation.

      This method should be called at the end of every simulation loop iteration to ensure statistics are calculated based on the most recent data.

      Parameter:
      vehiclesInfo - A map containing the current vehicles, keyed by their ID.
      step - The current time step index of the simulation.

    • avgVehiclesSpeed

      public double avgVehiclesSpeed()
      Calculates the arithmetic mean speed of all active vehicles in the network.
      Gibt zurück:
      The average speed in m/s, or 0.0 if no vehicles are active.

    • findCongestionSpots

      public List<String> findCongestionSpots()
      Identifies road segments (edges) where traffic is congested.

      Congestion is defined as an edge where the average speed of all vehicles on that edge is below a threshold of 5.0 m/s.

      Gibt zurück:
      A list of edge IDs representing the congestion spots.

    • calculateVehicleDensity

      public Map<String,Integer> calculateVehicleDensity()
      Calculates the density of vehicles on each edge.
      Gibt zurück:
      A map associating Edge IDs (Key) with the number of vehicles currently on that edge (Value).

    • calculateTravelTimeDistribution

      public Map<String,Integer> calculateTravelTimeDistribution(int binSizeSeconds)
      Calculates a histogram of current travel times for all active vehicles.

      The method groups vehicles into time bins (e.g., "0-10", "10-20") based on how long they have been in the simulation. The travel time is calculated as: currentSimTime - departureTime.

      Note: This method assumes a simulation step length of 0.1 seconds.

      Parameter:
      binSizeSeconds - The size of the time buckets in seconds (e.g., 10 for 10-second intervals).
      Gibt zurück:
      A TreeMap sorted by time range, mapping the range string (e.g., "10-20") to the vehicle count.
